source: AAA gasprices.aaa.com national average, May 20 2026 ($4.555, +2.2¢ d/d vs $4.533 May 19). Trump's 05-18 postponement of a 'scheduled' May 19 strike on Iran held through May 20; despite Brent sliding to ~$107 and WTI cracking below $100, pump prices kept climbing on the standard 1-2 week crude pass-through lag, cargo backlog, and damaged regional refining. Per AAA: +52.3% above $2.99 Feb 28 baseline; ~$1.40/gal above year-ago levels; highest US national avg since 2022 peak ($5.016 Jun 14 2022). California highest at $6.15; Washington $5.77; Hawaii $5.64; Oklahoma lowest at $3.94. Trump 05-11 federal gas-tax suspension (18.4¢) still in legislative pipeline; no enactment through 05-20.
